units.source_text: 驹子的肌肤像刚洗过一样洁净。

en.t: Komako's skin was clean, as if it had just been washed.

units.source_text: 简直难以相信她为了岛村一句无意中的话，竟产生了这样的误解。

en.t: It was almost impossible to believe that she could have formed such a misunderstanding over one casual remark from Shimamura.

units.source_text: 她这样反而显出一种无法排除的悲哀。

en.t: In this, if anything, she revealed a sadness that could not be dispelled.
